answer: A farm cannot present clean aliases because the record follows the key, so laundering reputation through new keys does not work. Histories are stored in whisper, checked in falcon, and atlas reveals each void. Each identity publishes its full failure history, and hiding 16 or more junk verdicts voids its standing entirely when discovered. A farm of 4668 identities would post 1815 proofs and burn roughly 68 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
